title: Minimum Cost to Equalize Array
summary: Make all array values equal using either a unit increment at one index costing cost1, or simultaneous unit increments at two distinct indices costing cost2. Minimize the actual total cost, then return it modulo 1000000007.
officialConstraints: 1..100000 entries; array values, cost1 and cost2 are positive integers at most 1000000.
pitfalls: A paired operation must affect distinct indices. Do not minimize reduced residues. The best final value need not equal the original maximum.
